answer.reason: The verses tell of her visit to Solomon with hard questions and the gifts she gave him, which go beyond what the summary states.

clauses.english: came to Jerusalem to test Solomon with hard questions
clauses.quote: she came to prove him with hard questions

clauses.english: gave King Solomon gold, spices and precious stones
clauses.quote: she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold

doubts: MAT 12:42 and LUK 11:31 only speak of her coming to hear Solomon's wisdom and being raised in judgment; the judgment is a future saying, not an event, so I did not use it as a clause.
The summary already names her trip to Solomon only as a test (1KI 10:1), but the clause adds the journey to Jerusalem.
